title: PURL (Package URL)
summary: A PURL (Package URL) is a standardized URL for software packages: pkg:{type}/{namespace}/{name}@{version}?{qualifiers}#{subpath}. Types: npm, pypi, maven, gem, nuget, cargo, golang, docker, deb, rpm, etc. PURLs are used in SBOMs (Software Bill of Materials) and vulnerability databases.

notes: type: package ecosystem (npm, pypi, maven, gem, nuget, cargo, golang, docker, deb, rpm, etc.).
qualifiers: key=value pairs (arch, os, distro, etc.).
PURLs are used in SBOMs and vulnerability databases (CVE, OSV).
